node.doctext:
$VAR1 = '$VAR1 = \'{ "name" : "dsfsdfs", "age" : "23", "city" : "vvvvv", "state" : "aaaa", }\';

Wait, is that really the output that you get from print Dumper($params);? That would mean that $params is in fact a string of [doc://Data::Dumper] output - in other words someone is POSTing that to your script? Could you please clarify, preferably with an [id://1177642|SSCCE]?
